name: ne-agent · 全量测试
description: 在 /workspace/小说系统 跑全 workspace 测试并汇总通过/失败数。失败即中止，不掩盖。

config.command: export PATH=/opt/taixu/toolchains/rust/bin:$PATH; cd ${PROJECT_DIR}; cargo test --workspace > /tmp/ne-test.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -50 /tmp/ne-test.log; echo "cargo 退出码 = $rc"; test $rc -eq 0

python3 - <<'PY'
import re
t=open('/tmp/ne-test.log',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
tot=sum(int(m) for m in re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed',t))
fail=sum(int(m) for m in re.findall(r'(\d+) failed',t))
ign=sum(int(m) for m in re.findall(r'(\d+) ignored',t))
print(f'✅ 总通过 {tot} · 失败 {fail} · 忽略 {ign}')
PY
